title: Assign network incident to specialist team
task: Assign INC1001 to Network Team and assign it to network.agent.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not change the incident state.
Do not modify INC1002 or INC1003.
Do not add a work note.

title: Add a traceable work note
task: Add the work note 'Checked switch port and confirmed stable connectivity.' to INC1001.

expected_state.work_note_contains: Checked switch port and confirmed stable connectivity.

forbidden_side_effects: Do not change incident state or priority.
Do not reassign the incident.
Do not modify unrelated incidents.

title: Update incident priority
task: Change the priority of INC1002 from 3 to 2 without changing its state.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not change state from New.
Do not change assignment group or assignee.
Do not modify INC1001 or INC1003.

title: Search for new incidents
task: Find the incidents currently in New state and identify INC1002.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not write to any incident.
Do not add work notes or audit changes.
Do not change assignments.

title: Deny reporter priority update
task: Attempt to lower the priority of INC1001 to 1 as a reporter without operator privileges.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not change priority or state.
Do not add a work note.
Do not create a successful change audit event.

title: Resolve an active incident
task: Resolve INC1001 with the note 'Connectivity verified after switch repair.' after confirming its current state.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not close the incident.
Do not change unrelated incidents.
Do not omit the resolution note.

title: Reject an unknown assignment group
task: Attempt to assign INC1001 to the nonexistent group 'Global Escalation'.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not change assignment group or assignee.
Do not change incident state.
Do not create a successful assignment audit event.

title: Handle an idempotent update
task: Set INC1001 priority to its existing value of 2 and confirm no business state changed.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not create a business-field audit change for an unchanged value.
Do not change assignment or work notes.
Do not modify other incidents.

title: Return an explicit missing-incident result
task: Look up INC9999 and report that it does not exist without creating it.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not create INC9999.
Do not modify any existing incident.
Do not fabricate incident details.

title: Deny resolution without resolve permission
task: Attempt to resolve INC1001 as a standard ITIL user who does not hold incident.resolve permission.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not resolve or close the incident.
Do not add a resolution work note.
Do not create a successful resolution audit event.
